entities.summary: The Ambara church is located near village Miusera in the Gudauta District, Abkhazia/Georgia, on the cape of Miusera, close to the mouth of the Ambara stream. Ambara three-nave basilica represents an important example of this type of architectural monuments. Ambara church has been given the status of cultural heritage monument.
